steps.title: Prepare a current source
steps.student_goal: Select a wire or solenoid and give it a nonzero current state.
success_criteria: A wire or solenoid has a nonzero current state.
The selected source is available for magnetic field-line observation.

steps.title: Observe one current-carrying wire
steps.student_goal: Observe field-line direction and density around a straight current-carrying wire.
success_criteria: Student observes field lines around the wire.
Student connects field direction with the right-hand rule.
Student connects denser magnetic field lines with stronger field.

steps.title: Compare wire and solenoid fields
steps.student_goal: Compare magnetic field patterns produced by a straight wire and a solenoid.
success_criteria: Student identifies circular field patterns around a straight wire.
Student identifies concentrated field lines through the solenoid interior.
Student explains how current direction changes magnetic field direction.
